desc.zh: 从具体星号替换出发，按最后一个字母分组，推导常数空间的前缀计数。
desc.en: Count concrete wildcard choices, partition by the final letter, and derive constant-space prefix counting.

concepts.name: Disjoint final-token counting
concepts.description: Count valid one-digit and two-digit endings without admitting zero as a wildcard.

concepts.name: Rolling prefix decoding counts
concepts.description: Extend the two preceding prefix counts through disjoint final-token cases.
